Lantern River Template

Lantern River is a one-page template for a creative studio, built around a 3D night river inspired by Hoi An. As you scroll, a glowing lotus lantern floats down the water past lantern-lit shophouses, a covered bridge, a market, a sampan pier and a fireworks bend. Each stop opens one section: intro, studio, work, services, pricing and contact.

The work section is a string of hanging lantern cards that light up when clicked. Services sit on folding paper ribs that open on click, and pricing is a set of three paper lanterns. Behind them, clear water reflects the town, koi swim around your lantern, and you can choose from three gentle background sounds. Free Drift mode lets visitors steer one of seven lanterns, with a speed boost, a little speedometer, and pinch zoom or a joystick on phones.

The template is built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Three.js, with local copies of the Three.js files and only Google Fonts loaded online. It is fully responsive and supports reduced motion. The contact form has validation and on-screen notices.
